title: Houthis Hit Ras Tanura as Their War on Saudi Oil Reaches Both Coasts
dek: Riyadh confirms a Houthi missile struck its largest refinery; the group's claimed hits on the East-West pipeline and Yanbu remain unconfirmed.
body: Ras Tanura refines 550,000 b/d. Nearly all Saudi crude leaves via Ras Tanura on the Gulf or Yanbu on the Red Sea.

panels.label: The Houthis Say
panels.text: The Houthis say Saudi-linked ships and sites are targets, and other shipping can pass freely if governments stay out.

panels.label: The Coalition Says
panels.text: Coalition spokesman Turki al-Maliki pledges "deterrent operational measures" and says strikes on Houthi launchers protect civilians.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Each side says it is defending itself; at stake is who can shut Saudi oil's last open routes while Hormuz stays closed.
